title: Certifying Model Upgrades with Slice-Wise Non-Regression and Incumbent Fallback
abstract: arXiv:2609.13714v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An updated model can improve an aggregate metric while degrading a slice that matters to a downstream user. We study checkpoint selection subject to non-regression tolerances relative to a retained incumbent. The central distinction is between failing to detect harm and certifying non-inferiority: the former can release harmful updates with high probability when evaluation is noisy. We give a reproducible release procedure that separates candidate search from independent, paired evaluation and returns the exact incumbent when certification fails. Applying established intersection-union and Learn-then-Test principles, we state finite-sample guarantees for one frozen candidate, a finite candidate library, and a prespecified testing order. A joint release decision does not require a slice-count Bonferroni penalty, although certification power can still decrease with the number of slices. In bounded-score simulations, a no-detected-harm gate

translated_title: 基于切片级无退化认证与现任模型回退的模型升级验证
translated_abstract: 更新后的模型可能在提升总体指标的同时，降低对下游用户重要的某个数据切片上的性能。我们研究了在相对于所保留现任模型满足无退化容差约束下的检查点选择问题。其核心区别在于“未能检测到损害”与“认证非劣性”之间的差异：前者在有噪声的评估环境下可能以较高的概率发布有害的更新。我们提出了一种可复现的模型发布流程，该流程将候选模型搜索与独立的配对评估相分离，并在认证失败时精确返回现任模型。通过应用成熟的交集-并集检验与“先学习后检验”原则，我们为单个冻结候选模型、有限候选库以及预先指定的检验顺序给出了有限样本保证。联合发布决策无需按切片数量进行Bonferroni多重检验惩罚，尽管认证功效仍可能随切片数量的增加而下降。在有界分数模拟实验中，“未检测到损害”门控
tldr: 本文提出一种可复现的模型升级发布流程，通过切片级非劣性的统计认证提供有限样本保证，并在认证失败时回退到现任模型，从而避免发布损害下游用户切片的有害更新。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reproducible model release procedure that certifies slice-wise non-regression with finite-sample statistical guarantees and falls back to the incumbent model upon certification failure, preventing harmful updates from degrading slices important to downstream users.
